lib.missing_ask: {count} files are no longer in the library folder (deleted or moved in Explorer?). If you deleted them on purpose, confirm — the phones will then show them as no longer backed up.

send.hint: Send files, folders or photos to another PC running {app} on the same network. Interrupted transfers continue where they stopped.

send.none_nearby: No new PC found. Paired PCs are listed above. To add one, open {app} on it, then press Search.
send.received_folder: Files from other PCs are saved in
send.forget_body: Like Disconnect, and this PC also stops listing it under “Nearby” (you can show it again there). Files already sent stay where they are.
send.pair_check: Check that the other PC shows the same three symbols.
send.err_peer_offline: The other PC is not reachable. Is it on, with {app} open?
send.err_not_paired: The other PC no longer knows this one. Pair again.
send.err_library_offline: The other PC's library folder can't be found (deleted, moved, or drive unplugged). It needs fixing on that PC; then send again.
send.err_file_missing: A file was moved or deleted before it was sent.
send.err_file_changed: A file changed while it was being sent. Send it again.
send.err_pair_expired: Nobody answered on the other PC in time.
send.err_cannot_reach: Could not reach the other PC.
send.err_sha256_mismatch: A file arrived damaged and was not kept. Send it again.
send.err_too_many_attempts: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
pair.check_pc: Check that the other PC shows the same three symbols. Allowing lets both PCs send to each other.
send.err_cert_changed: The other PC shows a different security certificate (reinstalled, or something is in between). For safety nothing was sent. Forget it and pair again.
send.err_upgrade_required: This device must use an encrypted connection. Update {app} on it.
send.err_not_lan: Only devices on the same home or office network can connect.
receive.not_encrypted: Encryption unavailable (certificate could not be created) — transfers are not encrypted.
common.clear_hint: Only removes finished entries from this list on this PC. No file is deleted, and the other device is not affected.
send.where: Photos and videos go into the other PC’s library. PDF and Office documents go into the “Documents” folder and everything else (archives, whole folders…) into the “Other files” folder — both inside the same library folder.
send.disconnect_body: Both PCs stop sending to each other. Each still sees the other under “Nearby” and can pair again with one click. Files already sent stay where they are.
send.drag_hint: You can also drag files or folders from Explorer onto a PC above.
text.saved: Saved as {name} in the Documents folder.
receive.other_ways_hint: Scan the QR code or type the PIN on the phone instead.
lib.recent: Just received: {count} items from {from} (they are placed by the date they were taken, so older ones are further down).
lib.recent_only: Showing only what arrived in the last 24 hours.
settings.auto_accept_hint: On: paired phones and PCs send without asking. Off: the first transfer from each device waits for “Accept” here; after that it may keep sending for 30 minutes.

incoming.window: If you accept, what this device sends in the next 30 minutes is received without asking again. Turn on “Receive automatically” in Settings to never be asked.
files.delete_body: It goes to the Recycle Bin; you can restore it from there.
files.empty_docs:
No documents yet.
PDF, Word, Excel… sent from another PC appear here.
files.empty_other:
Nothing here yet.
Archives, whole folders and other files sent from another PC appear here.
home.other_pcs_none: No other PC paired yet — pair one under Send.

reason.later: Not a good time — please send later
reason.too_big: Too much — please pick a few
incoming.guest_hint: This is a temporary device here: each transfer needs your OK. Regular devices send straight in.
pair.family_or_guest: Regular device: what it sends arrives straight away (backups). Temporary device: each transfer waits for your OK. You can change this later on the Devices page.
family.pcs_hint: What these PCs send arrives straight away.
family.guests_hint: Each transfer from a temporary device waits for your OK here.
family.join_title: “{name}” asks to become a regular device
family.join_body: As a regular device, what it sends arrives here straight away (no “Accept” needed) — e.g. automatic backups.
home.guests_none: No temporary devices. Devices paired as “temporary” show up here.
settings.accept_rule_hint: Regular devices send straight in (backups); temporary devices wait for your OK each time. Set it per device on the Devices page.
send.in_my_family: My regular device: what it sends arrives straight away
send.my_guest: My temporary device: what it sends waits for my OK
send.me_family_there: I'm its regular device: what I send goes straight in
send.me_guest_there: I'm its temporary device: what I send waits for their OK
send.ask_family_there: Ask to become its regular device
send.ask_family_waiting: Asked “{name}” — waiting for an answer there…
send.now_family_there: You are now a regular device of “{name}”.
send.now_guest_there: You are now a temporary device of “{name}”.
send.err_no_answer: Nobody answered on the other side in time.
send.err_old_version: The other PC has an older {app}. Update it first.
recover.unplugged_title: The library drive is not connected
recover.unplugged_body: {path} can't be reached — external drive unplugged? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted. Plug it back in and everything resumes by itself. If the library now lives somewhere else, point to it.
recover.gone_body: {path} is no longer there — deleted or moved? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted yet. Choose what to do:
recover.bin_hint: In the Recycle Bin, find the folder, right-click it → Restore. {app} picks it up again by itself.
recover.open_bin: Find it in the Recycle Bin
recover.relocate: It was moved: point to it…
recover.recreate: Start again with an empty library
recover.not_library_body: {path} is not a moved {app} library. Use it as the library from now on anyway? What was in the old one is then treated as no longer on this PC, and phones offer to send it again.
recover.recreate_title: Start again with an empty library?
recover.recreate_body: An empty {path} is created and receiving resumes. Everything that was in the lost folder is recorded as no longer on this PC: phones show those photos as not backed up and can send them again with one tap. Only do this if the folder is really gone (not in the Recycle Bin, not moved).
recover.recreated: Library made anew. {count} items recorded as no longer on this PC; phones will offer to send them again.
recover.failed: Could not create the folder (no permission? drive full?).
home.issue_gone: The library folder is gone (deleted or moved) — open the Library to fix it.
send.phone_ready: Can receive now — they will be asked to accept
send.phone_closed_hint: Open {app} on the phone to send to it (an iPhone receives only while the app is open)
send.err_phone_closed: The phone is not receiving now. Open {app} on it and send again.
phonefmt.title: {count} files need converting so “{name}” can show them
phonefmt.jpeg: {count} photos → high-quality JPEG (date, place and camera info kept)
phonefmt.h264: {count} videos → MP4 the phone plays, near-original quality (H.265 on the graphics chip when this PC has one — fast; otherwise H.264, which can take a while)
phonefmt.note: The originals on this PC stay as they are; the converted copies are only for sending. Everything else goes as it is.
send.phone_online_not_ready: Online, but its receiver isn't ready. Close {app} on the phone and open it again; if this stays, update {app} on the phone.
send.err_disk_full: Not enough space on the other PC. Nothing was sent half-way; free up space there and send again.
send.err_too_large: The other side refused it as too large.
settings.log_hint: Records what happened and what went wrong, so problems can be found. Stays on this device, never sent anywhere; no photo contents, passwords or codes. Export it only when you want to give it to someone helping you.
family.access_manage: Can browse and delete (to Recently deleted)
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: No account, nothing collected. {app} has no servers of its own.
privacy.p2: Photos, videos and files go straight between your own devices on the same network — never through the internet or a cloud.
privacy.p3: Everything sent is encrypted. When pairing, both screens show the same three symbols, so you know it is your own device; after that only that device is trusted.
privacy.p4: No statistics, no ads, no tracking. The app only uses the network to find your devices and send between them.
privacy.p5: The diagnostics log stays on this device and holds no photo contents; it leaves only if you export it.
privacy.p6: Open source (GPL-3.0): anyone can check the code at github.com/lixuedenon/localroll.
privacy.perms: On this PC: received files stay in the library folder you chose; the firewall rule only opens {app}’s port to your home or office network.
pdf.open_with: Open with the usual PDF program

dev.hint: Who you send to, who can send here, who may see the library — all here.
dev.family_hint: Files they send come straight in
dev.guests_hint: Files they send wait for you to click “Accept”

home.all_good_sub: Anything that needs you shows up here
home.devices_none: No devices yet. Click “Add a device”.
jobs.hint: Copies Windows can open; originals are always kept.

dev.family_explain: When it sends files to this PC, they come straight in without asking (good for automatic backups).

library.hover_hint: Live Photos and videos: hover the mouse to play
open.google_body: This is a shortcut to a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides; the document itself is online. It needs the internet and a Google account that may open it. To pass it on offline, first “Download” it from Google as Word or PDF and send that.
open.google_no_link: This shortcut has no usable address.
office.simple_note: Simple preview: text, tables and pictures only; the layout may differ from the original.
office.cant_read: This file can’t be read (it may be damaged, or an old .doc / .xls / .ppt file).
office.empty: Nothing to show in this file.
send.err_phone_full: The phone doesn't have enough free space. Nothing was sent half-way; free up space on it and send again.
trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.confirm_body: They go to {app}'s "Recently deleted" and can be restored for 30 days; after that they are deleted for good. Phones are told on their next connection that these photos are no longer on this PC.
trash.not_all: {count} could not be deleted (perhaps open in another program)
trash.info: Items here are deleted for good after 30 days. {count} items, {size}.
lib.copies_selected: Also {count} converted copies ({size}), not shown in the list

pick.copies_hint: Converted copies: the originals stay; you can convert again any time.
files.rename_taken: A file with that name is already there
files.rename_failed: Couldn't rename (perhaps the file is open)
search.hint: Search text in photos and files
search.progress_note: {done} of {total} read — what isn’t read yet can’t be found
search.off_note: Text reading is off in Settings: only names are searched
search.no_ocr_note: Windows here can’t read text in pictures: names and document text are searched
search.title: Text search
search.enable: Read the text in photos and files, to search it
search.enable_hint: On this PC only, no internet. It works in the background while the PC is quiet and pauses while files are sent or received.
search.state_no_ocr: Windows here can’t read text in pictures; only document text is read
search.state_paused: Paused while files are sent or received: {done} / {total}
search.cn_ready: Chinese can be read now. Photos will be read again.
search.installing: Installing… this can take a few minutes. Allow it if Windows asks.
search.install_failed: It didn’t install. Please try the steps below.
search.cn_missing_title: Chinese text can’t be read yet
search.cn_missing_body: Windows on this PC has no Chinese text recognition. It can read: {langs}. Add it once (free, from Windows itself):
search.install_auto: Install Chinese reading in one click
search.step1: Click “Open language settings” (or: Settings › Time & language › Language & region).
search.step2: Next to “Preferred languages”, click “Add a language”.
search.step3: Search “Chinese”, choose “中文(简体，中国)”, then “Next”.
search.step4: Keep “Optical character recognition” ticked, untick “Set as my Windows display language” if you don’t want that, then “Install”.
search.step5: When it’s installed, come back here and click “Check again”.
search.picture_download_failed: The picture model could not be downloaded. Check the internet connection and try again.
search.picture_offer: Search by what pictures show? Then words like “beach”, “dog” or “birthday cake” find the photos and videos that show them — no tagging needed. It needs a recognition model (about {size}, downloaded once from {app}’s own release page); after that everything runs on this PC and no photo is uploaded. Not downloading it is fine: text search and everything else work as usual, you just can’t search by picture. You can turn it on later in Settings › Text search.
search.picture_explain: Type “beach” or “dog” to find the photos and videos that show it. Needs a recognition model once (about {size}); everything runs on this PC and no photo is uploaded. Leaving it off changes nothing for text search or anything else.
search.picture_remove: Remove the model from this PC (frees {size})
people.title: People
people.explain: Puts photos of the same person together; you can name people and search by name. Everything runs on this PC, face data stays in the library and is never uploaded. Leaving it off changes nothing else.
people.offer: {app} will find the faces in your photos and put photos of the same person together. You can name each person, then type the name in the search box (like “Mum” or “Mum beach”) to find their photos. All recognition happens on this PC; neither photos nor face data are uploaded. Face data is kept in the library’s .localroll folder and goes wherever the library goes. Not turning it on is fine: everything else works as usual. You can turn it off or delete all face data any time in Settings › Text search.
people.no_models: This build doesn’t include the face models. Please update {app}.
people.none_yet: Nobody found yet. With many photos this takes a while; people show up here as they are found.
people.hint: Click a person to see their photos; right-click to name, merge (when one person is in two groups) or hide.
people.name: Name
people.merge_title: Who is this? Pick the same person
people.name_note: The name is kept in this library only. Once named, you can search for them by name.
people.clear_confirm: This deletes every face, group and name found in this library and turns People off. The photos themselves are not touched. Turning it on again later starts recognition from scratch.
pick.when_hint: No dates chosen: any time. First pick which date counts.
lib.senders_tip: Devices that sent things here; the names are the ones set on the phones
search.progress_where: See how far text, pictures and people have been read in Settings › Text search
search.ocr_broken_title: Windows text recognition isn't working on this PC
search.ocr_broken_body: File names and documents can be searched; photos wait. It is tried again every half hour, or press “Check again”. What Windows said:
search.state_failed: Paused: no answer from the model (tried again in 30 min; details in the diagnostics log)
send.offline_hint: Offline devices can be chosen too: it starts by itself when they come online (up to 7 days).
send.queued_held: {name} is offline: it will be sent as soon as it comes online.
send.err_expired: Waited 7 days and the device never came online: cancelled
library.title_tip:
Live Photos and videos: they play when the mouse rests on them.
Selecting: rest the mouse on a photo and a circle appears top left — click it. Ctrl+click adds one at a time, Shift+click picks a run, or drag a box with the mouse.
lib.senders_tip_long:
Filter by sender: show only what one device sent.
Names are the ones set on the phones or PCs; one person's phones with the same name count as one person. “This PC” is what was copied into the library directly.
people.tip: People: photos of the same person together; name and merge them, and once named, find them by name in the search box. All worked out on this PC, nothing uploaded.
pick.tip: Select by conditions: by time, sender, type and size, pick a big batch at once, then export, send, convert or delete them together.
library.size_tip: Thumbnail size: small / medium / large — small shows more at once, large shows more clearly.
trash.tip: Recently deleted: deleted photos and files wait here 30 days — restore them or delete them for good.
library.open_folder_tip: Open the library folder: in File Explorer; photos are in folders by year / month.
player.hint: Open photos and videos from anywhere on this PC.
player.folder_empty: There are no photos or videos in this folder.
player.drop_hint: You can also drag photos and videos from Explorer onto the {app} window, or right-click a file and choose “Open with → {app}”.
player.nothing_playable: These files aren’t photos or videos.
player.missing: The file isn’t there any more
player.ab: A-B loop (A): press at the start, then at the end
player.ab_set_a: Start A set — press again at the end (B)
player.key_seek: Video: back / forward 5 s · Photo: previous / next
player.key_zoom: Zoom in / out / fit (also the mouse wheel, double-click)
ink.send_shot: Send a screenshot to a device
ink.empty: No notes yet. Press the brush (D) to draw on the photo or video. On a video: draw while paused to pin it to that moment, or while it plays and each stroke appears at its own time.
ink.lead: When going to a note, start this much before
ink.key_shift: Hold while dragging: straight lines, squares and circles, turning in 15° steps
clip.title: Save a clip
clip.with_ink_tip: At the original’s size; the drawings appear as they were drawn. Takes a while.
clip.as_is_tip: Not re-encoded, done in seconds; starts at the key frame just before (maybe a little earlier).
clip.save_send: Save and send to a device
clip.making_ink: Making the clip with the drawings…
clip.of_note: Save a clip of this note…
clip.send_of_note: Send a clip of this note to a device…
player.notes_none_in_list: No notes on the files of this list yet.
rec.pick_mic_tip: {app} remembers it. If it can’t find it next time, it asks again.
rec.no_mic_tip: Check that a microphone is connected and that Windows “Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone → Let desktop apps access your microphone” is on.
rec.done_tip: A new video is made from the originals at their full quality, with your voice and drawings. Takes a while.
rec.discard_text: The voice recording and what was done while recording are deleted, and can’t be brought back.
rec.discard_ink: Also delete what was drawn while recording
rec.discard_ink_tip: Not ticked: the drawings stay in the notes.
rec.failed: The explanation video couldn’t be made
rec.delete_record_tip: The voice and the steps of the recording are deleted; the video can’t be made from it again. Videos already saved and drawings stay.
screen.title: What to record?
screen.window_tip: The recording follows the window if you move it (on this screen).
screen.area_tip: After “Choose the area”, drag a box on the screen. Esc cancels.
screen.drag_area: Drag a box around what to record · Esc cancels
screen.keys_tip: Work also from other programs: Ctrl+Shift+R start / stop, Ctrl+Shift+P pause, Ctrl+Shift+D pen. {app}’s own window is never in the video.
screen.fade_tip: On: each mark fades after 3 seconds. Off: it stays until you clear it.
screen.done_tip: The pen marks and click circles go into the video. Takes a while.
screen.pick_window: Click a window on the screen
screen.pick_window_tip: Move the mouse over a window, then click it. Esc: back.
clip.range_tip: Drag the two ends on the time line, then “Cut this”
convert.title: Convert to
convert.preset_tip_compatible: Opens on any Windows PC, close to the original's quality
convert.preset_tip_share: A small file for chat and email
convert.note_video: The original is not changed; the copy goes into “_converted”. H.265 needs the graphics chip or Windows' own encoder.
convert.note_image: The original is not changed. HEIC can be opened and converted, but not made.
screen.page_hint: Record any app, or explain a video at its own quality
screen.choice_window: Just one window, following it when it moves.
screen.choice_area: A part you draw a box around.

screen.explain_tip: It opens in the player and recording starts after 3-2-1.
pen.auto_return: Back to the mouse after each mark
pen.stylus: A stylus always draws, the mouse operates
pen.tips: Double-click a mark to select it, again to delete. Hold Ctrl while drawing to use the apps for a moment.
pen.missing: The screen pen is missing. Please reinstall {app}.
pen.only_tip: For teaching, meetings and demos. Ctrl+Shift+D anytime.
boot.certificate: Preparing secure connections (the first time only, this can take a minute)…
boot.tools: Getting the converter and player ready…
boot.tip1: Send photos, videos and files between phone and PC over the same Wi‑Fi — no cloud, no account.
boot.tip2: Phones can back up their photos to this PC automatically.
boot.tip3: The player opens almost any photo or video, HEIC and camera RAW included.
boot.tip4: Draw on a video as it plays, cut a clip, and send it straight to any device.
boot.tip5: Record your screen, draw on it, and send the recording straight to your phone.
boot.tip6: Search your photos with words: text in them, what is in them, or a person's name.
boot.tip7: Convert photos and videos to common formats — the original is never changed.
boot.tip8: Everything stays on your own devices — nothing is uploaded.

features.settings_tip: Everything it does and where. Switch: show it on Home.
features.transfer_tip: Phone ↔ PC, PC ↔ PC, on the same Wi‑Fi.
features.backup_tip: The phone's photos and videos, to this PC.
features.library_tip: All photos, videos and files by date; phones can browse it too.
features.search_tip: By the text in them, by what is in them, or by person.
features.player_tip: Photos and videos in any format; draw and annotate, cut clips, take screenshots.
features.screen_tip: Record any app, draw on the screen, explain a video at its own quality.
features.convert_tip: MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF, MP3, JPEG, PNG, WebP… — the original stays as it is.
features.phone: Browse this PC from your phone
features.phone_tip: Look through, search and save to the phone, with control over who sees what.
rec.around: Also take a little of the original before and after:
rec.name: File name
recs.title: My recordings
recs.rename_failed: Couldn’t rename it (the name is taken or the file is open).
recs.source_gone: The original file is no longer there.
